sources.snippet: The base HyperNix.3-mini was trained from scratch by ray0rf1re. SFT on it failed 3x (MCQ/echo priors too strong for 48M at that data scale). ray0rf1re agreed to a pretraining-continuation approach: keep the base, pretrain on more data, then SFT the identity on top.
